== Description ==

[[Paul Coggins]] (foreground table, navy polo, mustache, brown hair, looking at cards), [[Scott Lingrell]] (mid-right table, grey hoodie, glasses, grey hair, Nike sneakers, seated), [[Logan Pietig]] (mid hall toward the stream: green-and-gold Seattle jersey; olive zip at that table), and [[Matt Scott]] (mid hall, black jacket with a white sleeve stripe, grey shorts) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025.
